examples.sentence: 和五年前比，多数人的工资已经翻番了。
examples.romanization: hé wǔ niánqián bǐ， duōshù rén de gōngzī yǐjīng fānfān le。
examples.translation: Compared to five years ago, most people’s wages have doubled.

examples.sentence: 他出来得过于匆忙，居然忘了带手机。
examples.romanization: tā chūlái dé guòyú cōngmáng， jūrán wàng le dài shǒujī。
examples.translation: He came out too hurriedly and forgot to bring his mobile phone.

examples.sentence: 这儿坐吧，这个位空着呢。
examples.romanization: zhèr zuò ba， zhège wèi kōng zhene。
examples.translation: Sit here, this seat is vacant (which you perhaps didn’t know).

title: 乘机 (take this opportunity and)
longExplanation: take this opportunity and. Pinyin: chéngjī

examples.sentence: 这次出差去北京，我们可以乘机游览一下长城。
examples.romanization: zhè cì chūchāi qù Běijīng， wǒmen kěyǐ chéngjī yóulǎn yīxià Chángchéng。
examples.translation: On this business trip to Beijing, we can take the opportunity and take a tour of the Great Wall.

title: 不料 (who would have thought)
longExplanation: who would have thought. Pinyin: bùliào

examples.sentence: 我只想和她开个玩笑，不料她却生气了。
examples.romanization: wǒ zhǐ xiǎng hé tā kāi gè wánxiào， bùliào tā què shēngqì le。
examples.translation: I just wanted to joke with her, but who would have thought she got angry.

title: 未免+太+A+了 (can’t say it’s not too A)
shortExplanation: can’t say it’s not too A
longExplanation: can’t say it’s not too A. Pinyin: wèimiǎn+ tài+A+ le

examples.sentence: 警察赶到时未免太迟了。
examples.romanization: jǐngchá gǎn dàoshí wèimiǎn tài chíle。
examples.translation: The police arrived rather too late. (Lit. you can’t say they didn’t arrive too late.)

title: 未免+有些/有点+A (can’t say it’s not a bit A)
shortExplanation: can’t say it’s not a bit A
longExplanation: can’t say it’s not a bit A. Pinyin: wèimiǎn+ yǒuxiē/ yǒudiǎn+A

examples.sentence: 拒绝他的建议未免有些/有点失礼。
examples.romanization: jùjué tā de jiànyì wèimiǎn yǒuxiē/ yǒudiǎn shīlǐ。
examples.translation: It’s rather a bit rude to reject his suggestions. (Lit. you can’t say it’s not rude.)

examples.sentence: 他的工作是警察， 写小说仅仅是他的业余爱好而已。
examples.romanization: tā de gōngzuò shì jǐngchá， xiě xiǎoshuō jǐnjǐn shì tā de yèyú àihào éryǐ。
examples.translation: His works as a policeman, and writing novels is just his hobby (that’s all).

examples.sentence: 考上大学固然好，没考上大学也不是就没有出路了。
examples.romanization: kǎoshàng dàxué gùrán hǎo， méi kǎoshàng dàxué yě bùshì jiù méiyǒu chūlù le。
examples.translation: Granted, it’s good to go to college, [but even if] you don’t go to college it doesn’t mean you have no way out.

examples.sentence: 他这么努力地工作，无非想多挣些钱，让妻子、孩子生活得更舒适。
examples.romanization: tā zhème nǔlì dì gōngzuò， wúfēi xiǎng duō zhèng xiē qián， ràng qīzi、 háizi shēnghuó dé gèng shūshì。
examples.translation: He works so hard, simply [because] he wants to make more money and make his wife and children live more comfortably.

examples.sentence: 那次旅行大家都去了，唯独你没有去成。
examples.romanization: nà cì lǚxíng dàjiā dōu qù le， wéidú nǐ méiyǒu qù chéng。
examples.translation: Everyone went on that trip, only you didn't go.

examples.sentence: 你唱的明明是流行歌曲，哪里是京剧啊？
examples.romanization: nǐ chàng de míngmíng shì liúxíng gēqǔ， nǎlǐ shì Jīngjù ā？
examples.translation: What you are singing is obviously a pop song, how can you [say] it’s Beijing opera?

title: 大不了…… (If the worst came to the worst, …)
shortExplanation: If the worst came to the worst, …
longExplanation: If the worst came to the worst, …. Pinyin: dàbùliǎo……

examples.sentence: 失败了不要紧，大不了从头再来。
examples.romanization: shībài le bùyàojǐn， dàbùliǎo cóngtóu zài lái。
examples.translation: It doesn't matter if you fail. If the worst came to the worst, you can start from scratch again.

examples.sentence: 接个吻有什么大不了的？
examples.romanization: jiē gè wěn yǒu shénme dàbùliǎo de？
examples.translation: What's the big deal with a kiss?

title: V 于 PLACE (V in PLACE)
longExplanation: V in PLACE. Pinyin: V yú PLACE

examples.sentence: 著名的西湖龙井茶产于浙江看的西湖一带。
examples.romanization: zhùmíng de Xīhú lóngjǐngchá chǎn yú Zhèjiāng kàn de Xīhú yīdài。
examples.translation: The famous West Lake Longjing tea is produced in the West Lake area in Zhejiang.
